correctness.rationale: Single-codeword self reverse-complement feasibility leaves 72 of the C(4,2)*2^4=96 GC2 words. Independent direct distance construction gave 1168 compatibility edges, and a complete pivoted Bron-Kerbosch maximal-clique enumeration yielded size histogram 2:64,4:640,5:1024,6:512. A second direct check of every six-clique independently confirmed self RC distance 4, three disjoint pairwise distance-(4,4) edges forming a perfect matching, and other 12 pairs distance-(3,3). Explicitly generated the coordinate reversal centralizer of order 8 and alphabet Watson-Crick centralizer of order 8 and checked their 64 transformations on every maximum, giving orbit sizes 32x12 and 64x2. This finite graph enumerates all admissible codewords and all feasible codebooks; King provides prior optimum 6.

value.rationale: The exact equality layer of a standard DNA-code packing optimum is a natural complete classification: 512 optimal books, a rigid universal three-pair matching distance structure, and a specific symmetry orbit decomposition. Those structural restrictions matter when choosing inequivalent constant-GC code designs and do not follow mechanically from upper-bound value 6.
